description: This PHP source file defines the MediaStoreClient class for interacting with AWS Elemental MediaStore service, including method signatures for various container and policy operations.

classes.name: MediaStoreClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS MediaStore service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: createContainerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new MediaStore container.

methods.name: deleteContainerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a specified MediaStore container.

methods.name: deleteContainerPolicy
methods.description: Deletes the policy associated with a container.

methods.name: deleteCorsPolicy
methods.description: Deletes the CORS policy for a container.

methods.name: deleteLifecyclePolicy
methods.description: Deletes the lifecycle policy for a container.

methods.name: deleteMetricPolicy
methods.description: Deletes the metric policy for a container.

methods.name: getContainerPolicy
methods.description: Gets the policy of a container.

methods.name: getCorsPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the CORS policy for a container.

methods.name: getLifecyclePolicy
methods.description: Gets the lifecycle policy of a container.

methods.name: getMetricPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the metric policy for a container.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: putContainerPolicy
methods.description: Sets the policy for a container.

methods.name: putCorsPolicy
methods.description: Sets the CORS policy for a container.

methods.name: putLifecyclePolicy
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle policy for a container.

methods.name: putMetricPolicy
methods.description: Sets the metric policy for a container.

methods.name: startAccessLogging
methods.description: Starts access logging for a container.

methods.name: stopAccessLogging
methods.description: Stops access logging for a container.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
